It accepts Boolean/float/string `seed` and `sample_index` forms, `sample_index=-1`, and coercible values for declared integer overrides across easy/default/hard. 2. `generate(991, -1, difficulty="easy")` accepts the negative index and returns a grid with `self_check=[]`.
